pages.text: $(bold)Debug Terminal$()$(br2)Operators can right-click the terminal to edit parameters or use the control page for debug mode, cooldown override, hit notifications and log snapshots. Shift-right-click requests a snapshot directly. CSV files are read and written on the server.

$(bold)Config Inspector$()$(br2)A special item that displays entity and block data.$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)• Hold the config inspector$(br)• Right-click any entity or block$(br)• View detailed debug information$(br)• Useful for modpack developers

$(bold)Model Debug Block$()$(br2)A special block for testing model rendering.$(br2)$(bold)Features:$()$(br)• Displays model information$(br)• Shows animation states$(br)• Helps troubleshoot rendering issues$(br2)$(bold)Note:$() These tools are for development and testing only.
